# Story Package: The Good Shepherd (John 10:11; Psalm 23:1-3)

**Story Key**: `goodShepherd`

**Position in 365 Roadmap**: Core comfort / belonging story.

---

## Bible Story Retelling

Jesus said, “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.” He knows each one by name and leads them to green pastures and still waters. When one little lamb wanders away, the shepherd leaves the ninety-nine to find it and carries it home safely.

(John 10:11; Psalm 23:1-3)

---

## Coloring Page Prompt

Create one simple black-and-white line-art coloring page for ages 3–8. Clean bold outlines, large open spaces. Peaceful scene: Jesus as the Good Shepherd carrying a little lost lamb in His arms, with soft green hills and a quiet stream nearby. Focus on the heart moment of being safely found. Calm, tender, joyful.
